caption:
To high school softball… 

Four years. Endless blood, sweat, and tears. Being a part of this program wasn’t always easy. Overcoming internal struggles and the environment almost broke me. But I didn’t play for the wins or the stats at the end of the day, I played to improve the culture. I set out to be the difference, to lead with heart, and to leave things better than I found them. It wasn’t perfect, and it wasn’t always easy, but I loved every moment. These past four years gave me purpose, power and pride, and I wouldn’t change it for the world. Thank you to my teammates, coaches, fans, and Welly nation from the bottom of my heart.

With that being said, T. Payne is officially signing out ✌🏽

#statechampions #senioryear #18

caption:
To my better half and our baby Bear on today's final high school softball game ever 💙🥎💪💕

With cleats dug in and spirits bright,
You've battled hard with all your might.
From practices long to games well-played,
A path to State you've bravely made.

The diamond calls, the tension hums,
As championship day finally comes.
Each swing, each throw, a practiced art,
Played with passion from the heart.

So step up strong, let courage gleam,
And chase that golden, winning dream.
For every cheer, for every shout,
Leave no shadow of a doubt.

Good luck, Wolverines - may fortune smile,
As you (hopefully) conquer this very last trial.
Bring home the rings, shining bright,
And celebrate with all your might!

I am proud to say that I have helped changed the culture of this team in a positive way and i can’t wait to watch what y’all will do next. My baseball career is over and I’m glad i got to go out with some great teammates.

Although it’s difficult to step away from a game that I have loved for so long, I believe that it is time and God has much bigger and brighter plans for me. Thank you to all of the teammates that became my brothers, it was one heck of a ride.

caption:
Com apenas 19 anos, meu pai se tornou o campeão mundial mais jovem da história do UFC. Mas o que mais me orgulha não é só a carreira lendária dele , é o homem que ele é fora do octógono.

Um marido amoroso, um pai presente e cheio de fé, um verdadeiro homem de Deus. Ser campeão é difícil… mas ser esse tipo de homem é ainda mais.

Pai, você não lutou só para entrar no Hall da Fama, você amou, ensinou e liderou com o coração. E isso vale mais que qualquer cinturão.

Parabéns, campeão. Você é meu herói, meu exemplo e meu melhor amigo. 🐐🏆 @vitorbelfort 

At just 19 years old, my dad became the youngest UFC world champion in history. But what makes me most proud isn’t just his legendary career, it’s the man he is outside the Octagon.

A loving husband, a present and faithful father, a true man of God. Being a champion is hard… but being that kind of man is even harder. And he did both.

Dad, you didn’t just fight your way into the Hall of Fame, you loved your way into the hearts of everyone around you.

Congratulations, champ. You’re my hero, my role model, and my best friend. 🐐🏆 @vitorbelfort

caption:
YES, HE CAN SHOOT! PACHECO🇵🇷

Carmelo Pacheco, uno de los talentos boricuas de tercer año a observar en la venidera temporada de la NCAA D1. Tras disputar su primera temporada de NCAA D1 con Mount St. Mary’s, este tirador NATO se trasladó a UCF para su año junior y se esperan grandes cosas de él. Veamos un resumen de su año sophomore: 

•9.5 PPG, 1.7 RPG, 1.3 APG
•77 PTS OF THREES (TEAM SEASON HIGH)
•LEAD THE MAAC IN 3PT% (46.4%)
•4TH IN ALL NCAA D1 IN 3P%
•KEY PIECE OF A MARCH MADNESS TEAM
.
Pacheco es uno de los mejores tiradores boricuas en la NCAA, si no el mejor y sus números y trayectoria lo validan. Un jugador que en high school fue nombrado en dos ocasiones como “District Player of the Year” y tras eso pasó a D2 en UVA Wise y posteriormente, a D1. 
.
Su habilidad y puntería para anotar el tiro desde la larga distancia son ESPECIALES y además, ha demostrado ser mucho más que solo un tirador de larga distancia. Se esperan grandes cosas de él en UCF esta temporada y es claramente un boricua a ponerle ojo en la NCAA.🫡🇵🇷
.

caption:
NATIONAL CHAMPIONS!!

I couldn’t have asked for a better way to end my travel softball career. The Aces Fastpitch Organization has become my family over the past few years. I am beyond thankful for the many opportunities they have given me on and off the field. I have so many memories with these girls that I will hold near my heart forever. I truly can’t express how much I love them. They have become the best friends I could have ever asked for. I can’t wait to watch every single one of you on the big stage. Thank you girls for everything. To the Taylors, thank you for believing in me even when I didn’t. I wouldn’t have gotten the opportunity to play at the next level if it wasn’t for you guys. As I move on to the next chapter I have to say it one last time, LETS GO ACES!!

A group of strangers who believed they only had athletics in common led to a bond I am so lucky to experience in life. Thank you @big12conference for the opportunity to reflect on culture, history, and immerse in self reflection. This program has given us so much and we hope more athletes get to experience how special it truly is and how much good it does<3

Love y’all with everything, until we see each other again❤️

caption: If you had the chance to know Ali, you were incredibly lucky. She was such a special person to everyone she met, always smiling and making everyone laugh. Ali was not only my first beach partner but also my first best friend. I considered her my sister. Words can't express how I feel right now, but I know she would want us to remember her with smiles, not tears. I am so thankful for all the memories we have shared and I will hold them deeply in my heart. I’m so grateful for the time I had her in my life, a gift I will never take for granted. Please take a moment to say a prayer for her family, and hug your loved ones tight. Life is truly too short. Fly high sweet girl, I love you🪽💛

caption: It’s hard to put into words how much this sport means to me. Volleyball has always been the one constant in my life, the place that kept me grounded. My volleyball journey has been far from perfect but it has taught me one thing and that is to always bet on yourself. Although having a career ending injury was not how I wanted my senior year to end, it made me appreciate the journey so much more. Looking back I realize how special all of this is. I got the opportunity to play the sport I love with people I love and all of the little things in between. 6yr old me dreamed of playing college volleyball and looking back to see I made it come true is so special. As I close this chapter of my life I know Gods plan is so much bigger! Thank you to everyone that was a part of my journey and thank you to Knight Nation!

caption: I’ve been putting off this post for a while, unable to find the words to express my gratitude to the sport that gave me so much. First, I’d like to start with God who blessed me with the abilities to be able to compete and play this sport with so much love, pride, and joy. My parents, who sacrificed so much of their time, energy and money in order for me to live out my dream these last 4 years. My coaches who pushed me throughout my career welcoming me into their gyms, as well as pushing me into new ones. Each and every one of my teammates, who will forever hold a special place in my heart. Thank you for always being there and sharing the blood sweat, tears and laughs. Lastly volleyball. It taught me countless life lessons, and always was there as my escape and safe place… my home away from home. I’m beyond grateful for everything this sport has given me, it will hold a forever lasting impact on my life. Not waking up at 6am for workouts, and planning my life around practice every day will be a scary transition. However, I am excited to see what my next chapter in life holds! #14 signing out🫶🏼🥺

caption: There’s not enough words or pictures to explain my love for this sport. I knew this post was coming, but I didn’t realize how hard it would be to describe the impact volleyball has had on me. Five long years of college volleyball and nine years of club volleyball, and it all still seems to have gone by so fast. The long days of practices, the roadtrips, the workouts, the wins, the losses, the athlete experience—they are nothing without the relationships and the memories you make along the journey. There is not a single person in my journey that I am not grateful to have met. I am truly blessed to have been able to play alongside my best friends for all these years. To know that is over, breaks my heart, but makes me excited for the next chapter of life. I am forever indebted to this sport for turning me into the person I am, giving me the sisters I never had, and giving me a lifetime of memories to look back on and smile. For anyone that knows my journey, there have been a lot of obstacles and set backs, but I would do it all over again in a heartbeat. To FGCU, you will forever hold a special place in my heart. You gave me the best four years I could have ever asked for and much more. To UCF, I am so grateful to have had the opportunity to compete in the Big 12 for my last year and I am so excited to see that program grow. #18 out❤️
